profile.headline: Senior Frontend Software Engineer - Design Systems at Target
profile.summary: Frontend engineer focused on design systems, accessible UI, and developer experience. I build scalable React/TypeScript components, patterns, and tooling for Target’s internal design system, partnering with UX, accessibility, product, and engineering teams to ship production-ready UI. My work spans Storybook, Figma design and collaboration, design tokens, component modernization, accessibility, CI/CD, and AI-assisted workflows that help teams build more consistent interfaces.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Software Engineer - Design Systems
Frontend Software Engineer - Design Systems
positions.description:
I work on Target’s internal design system building scalable frontend components, patterns, and developer workflows used across a large enterprise engineering ecosystem. My role combines frontend engineering, UX design and collaboration, accessibility, design systems, and developer experience. I partner with UX designers, accessibility experts, product teams, and engineers to shape component behavior, review design decisions, define implementation patterns, and support adoption across downstream teams.
 
Areas of focus include:
• Building reusable UI components and patterns for complex, data-rich internal applications 
• Translating Figma designs and design system standards into production-ready React/TypeScript components 
• Improving component APIs, accessibility behavior, responsive design, and developer ergonomics 
• Supporting v7 to v8 design system modernization through component refreshes, codemods, migration guidance, and documentation 
• Working with design tokens and theming decisions to improve consistency across refreshed components 
• Using Storybook for component development, documentation, prototyping, and review 
• Creating AI-assisted workflows and implementation guidance to help teams build, review, and migrate UI more consistently 
• Moving quickly on a small engineering team supporting hundreds of downstream teams while maintaining quality, accessibility, and long-term system scalability

positions.title: Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description:
This role gave me experience building production UI, collaborating across Agile teams, supporting internal cybersecurity workflows, and helping teams move toward shared frontend standards. My work included React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Git, Jira, CI/CD practices, debugging, code reviews, and cross-functional collaboration with engineers, product partners, and UX/design teams.
 
Areas of focus included:
• Building reusable frontend components and internal UI features with React and TypeScript 
• Supporting adoption from legacy UI patterns and MUI-based interfaces toward Target’s internal Canvas design system 
• Developing frontend experiences for internal security products and compliance-focused workflows 
• Helping improve visibility into security findings and developer workflows through internal tooling 
• Translating product and technical requirements into usable, accessible, production-ready UI 
• Collaborating through Agile ceremonies, Jira, Git-based workflows, pull requests, code reviews, and debuggin

positions.title: Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description:
At NewDay, I worked in a smaller startup-style environment where I owned frontend website development and helped improve internal workflows through programming. This experience gave me early ownership over building for real business needs, communicating with stakeholders, and translating goals into usable web experiences.
 
Areas of focus included:
 
• Building and enhancing the company’s first website 
• Creating responsive, user-centered web experiences aligned with business goals 
• Improving content structure, page flow, and usability 
• Partnering directly with stakeholders to understand needs and iterate on web updates 
• Building programming solutions that streamlined internal data and operational workflows
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership Development · Data Analytics · Microsoft Office · Team Management · Research · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Python (Programming Language) · Responsive Web Design · Stakeholder Management

positions.title: Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: JavaScript · User Experience Design (UED) · Leadership Development · TypeScript · React.js

positions.title: National Science Foundation Research Intern
positions.description:
Participated as an intern with the National Science Foundation in collaboration with Fisk University. Throughout the tenure of the internship my role was to:

•	Examine the nationwide trends of COVID-19 by utilizing various models, such as the SIR and SEIR mathematical modeling diagrams to develop my own mathematical model. This model was an expanded version of last year’s work.
•	Utilizing the developed model, I analyzed various large scale datasets.
•	I previous focused on data from the state of New York. This year I focused on the US as a whole. This involved gathering enormous amounts of data from every state including confirmed cases, hospitalizations, deaths, and vaccinations.
•	Applied Python coding language to display various graph types.
•	Presented my research and results to the scholars at Fisk University and the National Science Foundation.

positions.title: National Science Foundation Research Intern
positions.description:
Participated as an intern with the National Science Foundation in collaboration with Fisk University. Throughout the tenure of the internship my role was to:

•	Examine nationwide trends of COVID-19 by utilizing various models, such as the SIR and SEIR mathematical modeling diagrams to develop my own mathematical model. 
•	Utilizing the developed model, I analyzed various datasets in states such as Tennessee and New York.
•	Focused my research on the State of New York data and used my model to predict the trends of COVID-19. 
•	Applied Python coding language to display various graph types.
•	Presented my research and results to the scholars at Fisk University and the National Science Foundation.
